title: scene-plan.json
description: Deterministic mapping of each script scene to a render component + props. Replaces the old human-gated storyboard (fixed templates → no gate).

items.description: Either a single template+props, OR a `beats` array to split one script scene into several timed visuals (D-022).

engine.description: OPTIONAL render engine for this scene (default remotion). Set 'hyperframes' to route a single hero beat to a pre-rendered silent HyperFrames clip composited at the scene window (V6). Surgical — 1–3 per video at most.

props.description: Component props. Optional MOTIVATED-MOTION (opt-in, surgical — never global): `focalZoom`: { target:{x,y} (0..1), scale (<=~1.6), in/out (narration cue words) } punches into a target on cue and releases; `pip`: { anchor:'top-right'|'top-left', content, in/out } shows a corner inset. build-props resolves cue words to scene-local frames. Use ONLY for single-focus content (capture-segment, code-block, stat-callout, prompt cards) — NOT tables/lists/body text.

revealOn.description: Reveal sub-elements at each of this scene's sentence starts.

cueWords.description: Reveal sub-element i when this word is spoken.

beats.description: Split the scene into ordered visual beats; each covers a slice of the scene's sentences.
